name: Mixed Document Type Pack (CORD + FUNSD)
description: 10 CORD Korean/Indonesian receipts + 10 FUNSD business correspondence. Tests adaptive policy routing across document types. Each case carries only type-specific fields.

fields.total_amount: Amount the customer owed for their purchase. This is NOT the cash paid and NOT the change returned. Extract the number as-is including separators.
fields.subtotal_amount: Sum of items before tax. Usually slightly less than total_amount. Extract the number as-is.
fields.tax_amount: Tax or service charge added on top of subtotal. Usually a small fraction of subtotal_amount. Extract the number as-is.
fields.cash_amount: Payment made by the customer. Should be greater than or equal to total_amount. Extract the number as-is.
fields.change_amount: Amount returned to the customer after payment. Equals cash_amount minus total_amount. Extract the number as-is.
